dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Oh, I love the atmosphere in this tavern. It's lively, bustling, and there's no shortage of food and drinks. Ooh, speaking of which, I might go grab a few myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hmm? Leaving so soon? I think I'll hang around a while longer. These drinks are really hitting the spot...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hehe, that was a fantastic game, I had a blast! Huh? Tactics? Oh... Haha, I ran out of those a while back. By the end, I was relying purely on experience and instinct. Must still count for something, right?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Bravo, now that's what I call winning in style. I have to say though, I've never seen a deck like that before. Mind if I take a look?

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hmm? A round of cards? Sure, I do know a thing or two about this game.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Huh, I won. Must mean I've still got it, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Hmm, I lost... Guess I'll have to rethink my strategy.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No worries, let's just go all out and enjoy ourselves. No pressure on winning or losing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me adjust my deck first...

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Haha, well that was fun! If you're up for another round, I'll be ready whenever you are.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Well played — a victory well deserved! How was that then, enjoy yourself? If you'd like to play another round later, count me in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
